meta.title_en: Unconventional Trick | How Those Cinematic Trios Are Made
meta.topic: 封面设计 · 三拼图排版

scenes.context: 三张图都挺好看，但加上字总觉得怪怪的。先不换图，只把字改大，是不是一下就好看了。语域：封面设计，诊断演示。
sentences: 图好看，加上字总觉得怪。
The photos look great, but the text feels off.
feels off（怪怪的）
先不换图，只把字改大。
Keep the photos, just make the text bigger.
make the text bigger（把字改大）
一下就好看了。
Instantly better.
instantly better（一下就好看了）
paraphrase: 字改大 → make the text bigger / enlarge the type
怪怪的 → feels off / looks odd
scenes.speak: The photos look great, but the text feels off. Keep the photos, just make the text bigger. Instantly better.

scenes.context: 想更有王感（冲击感）一点，用网格重分。图还是这几张，只是谁大谁小，就有了安排。语域：封面设计，排版讲解。
sentences: 用网格重分，安排大小。
Regrid the layout to arrange the sizes.
regrid the layout（网格重分）
图还是这几张，谁大谁小有了安排。
Same photos, but size order creates the design.
size order（大小安排）
谁大谁小，就是设计。
Big and small — that's the design.
that's the design（就是设计）
paraphrase: 网格重分 → regrid / rebalance the grid
scenes.speak: Regrid the layout to arrange the sizes. Same photos, but size order creates the design. Big and small — that's the design.

scenes.context: 不想画面太满清爽一点，就把下面留出来，图推到角落，字放在空白里。这样画面没那么挤，文字也不用到处找位置。语域：封面设计，留白讲解。
sentences: 把下面留出来，图推到角落。
Leave the bottom open and push the photos to a corner.
push the photos to a corner（推到角落）
字放在空白里，画面不挤。
Text in the whitespace keeps the frame airy.
keeps the frame airy（画面不挤）
文字不用到处找位置了。
The type no longer hunts for a spot.
hunts for a spot（找位置）
paraphrase: 留白 → whitespace / empty breathing room
scenes.speak: Leave the bottom open and push the photos to a corner. Text in the whitespace keeps the frame airy. The type no longer hunts for a spot.

scenes.title_en: Break the Grid Into a Poster
scenes.context: 想要更有电影感、更像完整海报，就打破网格再拉开一点：上面放画面、下面做氛围。好看的海报都在用：网格分清楚，图放哪儿、字放哪儿、谁先被看见。语域：封面设计，收尾。
sentences: 打破网格，做成完整海报。
Break the grid to build a full poster.
break the grid（打破网格）
上面放画面，下面做氛围。
Visuals on top, atmosphere below.
atmosphere below（下面做氛围）
谁先被看见，是设计的核心。
What you see first is the core of design.
the core of design（设计的核心）
paraphrase: 打破网格 → break the grid / go off-grid
scenes.speak: Break the grid to build a full poster. Visuals on top, atmosphere below. What you see first is the core of design.

practice: Keep the photos, just make the text bigger.
Regrid the layout to arrange the sizes.
Leave the bottom open and push the photos to a corner.
Break the grid to build a full poster.
pitfalls: 「把字改大」用 make the text bigger。
Regrid the layout to arrange the sizes.
Leave the bottom open and push the photos to a corner.
「留出下面」用 leave the bottom open。
Who is seen first is important.
What you see first is the core of design.
「谁先被看见」用 what you see first。
shifts: 用 regrid（网格重分）、size order（大小安排）、whitespace（留白）
用 break the grid（打破网格）、atmosphere below（下面做氛围）、full poster（完整海报）
用 what you see first（谁先被看见）、the core of design（核心）、airy（不挤）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：王感→冲击感、某格→网格、揉出来→留出来、字方→字放、保定→抱定、吸管、头影→投影、拎出来→拎出来、关键词等。
